steps.title: Collect effluent samples
steps.instruction: Collect effluent samples using glass containers to accommodate potential oil remains from the power plant.

steps.title: Perform initial field testing
steps.instruction: Gather initial results using a Sigma SD900 Mobile Tester.

steps.title: Conduct physical-chemical and bacterial analyses
steps.instruction: Execute effluent studies at the Laboratory of Biotechnology, Materials, and Environment following Basic Protocols for the testing of Effluents and the specific methods listed below:

substeps.instruction: Analyze Thermotolerant coliforms (44°C), E. coli (44°C), and Yeasts and molds using NM ISO 9308–1 2007
Analyze coliforms (36°C) using NM ISO 9308–2 2007
Analyze Viable micro-organisms at 22°C and 36°C using NM ISO 6222 2007
Analyze Salmonella SPP using NF ISO 19,250
Analyze clostridia (37°C) and Vibrio cholera using NM 03.7.051 1996
Measure pH using NM ISO 10,523–2012
Measure Temperature using a probe thermometer
Measure Electrical conductivity using NM ISO 7888–2001
Measure Total dissolved salts using NM 03.7.019–1991
Measure Total suspended solids using NM EN 872:2013
Measure DBO5 using NM ISO 5815–1 ET 2–2012
Measure DCO using MA.315-DCO 1.1–2016
Measure Total nitrogen using NM ISO 5664–1999
Measure Bicarbonates using NM ISO 9963–1–2001
Determine Nitrates via calculation
Measure total phosphorus using NM ISO 11,885–2014
Analyze Sulfates, Hexavalent Chromium, and Mercury using NM EN 1483–2012
Measure Cationic detergents using NM ISO 7875–1 1999
Analyze Sulfide and Phenol index via Colorimetry
Measure Active chlorine and chlorine dioxide using NM ISO 11,885–2014
Measure AOX using NM ISO 6107-2
Measure Hydrocarbons using NM 00.6.151
Measure Oils and fats using NM ISO 872 (2013)
Analyze metals (Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Cadmium, Arsenic, Nickel, Lead, Total chromium, Cobalt, Sodium, Tin, Antimony, selenium, aluminum, Boron, Silver) as per the established analysis method
